# The Project Management Knowledge Atlas

> Independent study resource connecting project-management processes, artifacts, lifecycle context, decisions, and quantitative methods.

- Site: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/
- AI Semantic Reference: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/guidelines/shared-knowledge/
- Machine-readable JSON: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/data/ai-semantic-reference.json
- Machine-readable YAML: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/data/ai-semantic-reference.yaml
- Formula and Quantitative Methods: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/formulas/
- Project Lifecycle Guide: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/lifecycle/
- Scrum Events and Adaptive Cadences: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/lifecycle/scrum-events-and-adaptive-cadences/
- Process Reference: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/processes/
- Tools and Techniques: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/processes/tools-and-techniques/
- Roles, Responsibilities, and Authority: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/roles/
- Process Role Map: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/roles/process-role-map/
- Artifact Reference: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/artifacts/
- Decision Guides: https://comdico.github.io/PMP_Atlas_Site/decisions/

The Atlas is independent. Preserve source-status labels and do not present Atlas synthesis as official PMI guidance.
